title: Luxury 30A Vacation Home in Santa Rosa Beach with Golf Cart & Deck
meta_description: Winsome Dream offers a 4BR/4.5BA retreat for 11 guests with a golf cart, outdoor dining deck, and modern kitchen—steps from beach access and 30A attractions.
description_expanded: AboutWinsome Dream | Luxury 30A Vacation Rental in Santa Rosa Beach – Golf Cart Included, Close to the Beach, Gulf Place and Blue Mountain Beach Experience the perfect blend of coastal luxury and convenience at Winsome Dream, a stunning 30A vacation rental in the heart of Santa Rosa Beach, Florida. This upscale three-story home sleeps 11 guests and offers the ideal combination of premium amenities, comfort, and an unbeatable location close to the sugar-white sands of the Gulf of Mexico. With a 6-seater street-legal golf cart included, exploring 30A’s scenic communities, including Gulf Place, Blue Mountain Beach, and Dune Allen, is a breeze. Walk or ride to the Gulfview Heights Public Beach Access for a relaxing beach day, or stroll across the street to the iconic Goatfeathers Seafood Market and Restaurant for fresh Gulf-to-table dining. You will also be just minutes from boutique shopping, art galleries, and live music venues that make 30A one of Florida’s most beloved vacation destinations. Why Guests Love Winsome Dream: • 6-seater street-legal golf cart • Close to public beach access • Outside dining deck and outdoor shower • Outdoor grill for family cookouts • Open concept living area with abundant natural light • Fully stocked kitchen with stainless steel appliances and granite countertops • Two refrigerators for extra storage • Each bedroom has an ensuite bathroom • Four backpack beach chairs and a beach umbrella • Free high-speed Wi-Fi • Close to dining, shopping, and entertainment • Complimentary Starbucks coffee pack, creamer, sugar, bottled water, and a starter amenity package with paper towels, dish soap, sponge, kitchen wipes, dishwasher soap, laundry detergent pods, pillow spray, shampoo, conditioner, aloe, lotion, bathroom soaps, and toilet paper in each bathroom Spacious and Stylish Interior Winsome Dream’s second-floor open-concept layout combines bright, airy living spaces with a gourmet kitchen and a dining area perfect for entertaining. The chef’s kitchen features stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and a breakfast bar with seating for four. The living room’s plush furnishings and large windows invite guests to unwind, play games, or enjoy a movie night after a day of exploring. Step onto the private balcony to sip your morning coffee, read a book, or enjoy cocktails at sunset while feeling the refreshing coastal breeze. Bedrooms and Bathrooms This home offers four beautifully appointed bedrooms, each with a private ensuite bathroom for ultimate comfort: First Floor: King bedroom with ensuite and walk-in shower – ideal for guests seeking privacy and easy access. Second Floor: Queen bedroom with ensuite featuring a shower/tub combo – a comfortable retreat after strolling 30A in the evening. Third Floor: Primary Suite: King bed, private balcony with scenic 30A views, and a spa-like ensuite with a soaking tub and walk-in shower. Bunk Room: Queen-over-queen bunks with a twin trundle and private bathroom – perfect for children or additional guests. Outdoor Living The outside dining deck offers a relaxed space for evening meals under the stars, while the outdoor shower makes it easy to rinse off after a beach day. Fire up the grill for a fresh seafood dinner, or take the golf cart to one of 30A’s renowned restaurants. Prime Location for 30A Adventures Winsome Dream’s location places you close to everything that makes a Santa Rosa Beach vacation rental so special. Whether you spend your days soaking up the sun at the beach, browsing local shops, biking along 30A’s scenic path, or sampling fresh seafood, this home is your perfect launchpad for adventure. Book your stay at Winsome Dream today and experience a luxury 30A vacation rental designed for comfort, style, and unforgettable memories.
